# routeros_routing_pimsm_interface (Data Source)
Read `/routing/pimsm/interface` on RouterOS 7.25.1+. [CLI reference](https://manual.mikrotik.com/docs/7.25/cli-reference/routing/pimsm/interface/).

## Example Usage
```terraform
# RouterOS 7.25.1+. Requires the corresponding hardware/package.
data "routeros_routing_pimsm_interface" "example" {}
```
